title: Quiet company
old_caption: When a friend doesn't want to talk, you don't need the perfect words. Sit with them, find an edge piece, stay for the hour. Being there is a whole sentence.

title: Talk cards at friends' night
old_caption: One real question can turn a night of jokes into a night that matters. Ask what made your friends proud this year, then give the honest answer the room it deserves.

title: After the holidays
old_caption: The quiet days after the holidays can be harder than the holidays themselves. Check in after too: how are you doing now that it's quiet? Someone will be glad you asked.

title: The year's last friends' night
old_caption: A year of small check-ins adds up to this: the whole group in one room, and one more on the call. Thank you for being someone's friend first. Who are you sending this to?

title: The Friend You Drifted From
old_caption:
A whole year without talking, and no fight to blame.
Lead with warmth: "I miss you, no pressure to catch up on everything." Then say the hard part kindly.

title: Sorry, No "But"
old_caption:
The joke in the group chat didn't land, and now your friend has gone quiet.
Skip the defence. Call them, own it, and say sorry with no "but."

title: The Friend Who Only Vents
old_caption:
Always the listener, never the one who gets to share the big news?
You're allowed to ask for a turn. Good friends want to hear it. Send this to the friend who always listens.

title: Advice or Company?
old_caption:
When a friend's heart breaks, the urge to fix everything is love.
Ask first: do you want advice, or company? Sometimes just staying is the whole plan.

title: Take eleven of the voice note
old_caption:
Who re-records a voice note eleven times before sending it?
Watch for the reveal. Take one was already lovely.

title: The story posted for one viewer
old_caption:
Ever posted a story hoping exactly one person sees it?
Guess the sign, then just tell them you thought of them.
